quote: The proposed project aims to convert the long-neglected Jackson Lakes property into a vibrant 70-acre public park connected by a 3.5-mile greenway. This greenway will provide a safe, zero-emission route for residents to access crucial community assets, including Global Learning Academy. Transforming a blighted area into a community amenity, this initiative will not only create much-needed green space but also stimulate economic development, encourage active transportation, and improve access to parks. It is designed with equity in mind, ensuring disadvantaged residents benefit directly from the project's environmental and economic impacts.
author: DeLarian Wiggins
title: Council member, District 7
